{{Quote|Have you seen the latest on Senator Herbin? It's all over HNE. Dating that awful holovid actress from ''Republic Medcenter''. The one who protests about the war.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="NP" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the '''actress''', a protester of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], starred in a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] entitled ''[[Republic Medcenter]]''. Their performance and the film itself were given negative reviews by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the actress began dating [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senator]] [[Herbin]], despite his [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to [[Herbin's spouse|another individual]], resulting in a scandal widely publicized by [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]].<ref name="NP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The actress was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'', which was released in [[2009]] and written by [[Karen Traviss]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' multimedia project.<ref name="NP" />
